name: io.github.stefanoamorelli/nasdaq-data-link-mcp
title: Nasdaq Data Link (community)
description: Unofficial server for the Nasdaq Data Link Tables API: equities, funds, macro, commodities, crypto

environmentVariables.name: NASDAQ_DATA_LINK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Nasdaq Data Link API key. A free key (https://data.nasdaq.com/sign-up) reads the free tables and premium samples.

environmentVariables.name: NDL_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable, or 'all' (the default). 'core' is always on; the README lists the toolsets.
